scope: Only tests/chat-lifecycle.test.mjs and tests/rehearsal/experience.rehearsal.mjs changed. No product, operator, guard, authorization, HTTP or SQL implementation change.

findings.cause: The extensionless fake GIF payload now reaches the broadened native preparation path. This Node VM test has no DOM decoder and deliberately supplies no server-conversion capability, so the actual local failure is media_unavailable, not the prior media_format wording.
findings.correction: Renamed the test around preservation on preparation failure; assert media_unavailable on the draft, current useful error in chat and inline status, original/caption preserved, pending cleared and every POST absent.

findings.cause: A direct GET session observes SQL401 before the chat controller consumes its own revoked-session response and location.replace to /access or /admin/login. The fixture immediately navigated the still-running old document to its random attestation URL. Its queued sign-out redirect can win and return the signin document, exactly the initial assertion output.
findings.sourceEvidence: public/chat.js signOut() replaces location after clearPrivate; request/poll handlers call signOut on401. experience.rehearsal.mjs checked the other-device session401, then called login immediately without waiting for the old controller document to be replaced.
findings.correction: Only the two post-password-change reconnections set afterRevocation:true. login waits for the expected signed-out URL, complete login document, no workspace and a visible enabled real login form before calling the unchanged strict attest helper. No arbitrary sleep, retry of credentials, origin relaxation or auth bypass.
findings.cascade: The later clearing-preferences401 came from the client device whose reauthentication had failed at attestation; no second product fix or weakened assertion was added.

checks.probeScope: Actual attest/login helper source is evaluated against a deterministic browser-document scheduling model. Both roles reproduce old sign-out/proof collision, pass the new barrier and still reject an incorrect random proof before credentials. This is not native HTTPS or Chrome qualification.
checks.reason: No local Chrome/Chromedriver runtime; root retains initial CI logs and will qualify the next candidate.
